pages.title: The Three Commands
pages.text: Type these in chat any time to print your live progression:$(br)$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex balance$(): your token pool against the next tier's threshold.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex bosses$(): your boss-rush clear, per tier.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex submit$(): banks the eligible materials you carry into tokens.$(br2)Details: $(l:icraft:progression/check_your_standing)Check Your Standing$(/l).

The book cannot show live numbers, so these commands are how you ask the Codex where you stand.$(br2)If you prefer clicking, the $(bold)Submit$() buttons in the Engineering and Magic Crafting quest groups ($(k:heracles.open_quests)) do the same cap-safe banking as $(bold)/icraft codex submit$().$(br2)$(bold)Now run /icraft codex balance.$()
